claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For every nonempty affine coset D and nonconstant character chi, the genuine Boolean character-flip composition with a=chi(1-1_D), b=-chi 1_D, h=-chi has signed full-block associator Omega<=8 ln(2) I(b).

claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: The associator is exactly zero when chi varies on D, nonpositive when chi=+1 on D, and at most 4*2^-k*k*ln(2) when chi=-1 on a codimension-k coset.

claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For coordinate codimension-k subcubes on the negative character level, Omega/I(b) tends to 8 ln(2), so the source-influence coefficient is sharp within the class.

claims.label: CONDITIONAL_CLASS_THEOREM
claims.statement: For adaptive nonreusing hierarchies whose reached local branch pairs have the affine-coset character-flip form and whose b_v are restrictions of one source b, sum_v w_v Omega_v<=8 ln(2) I(b).
claims.scope_note: The affine-coset local hypothesis is essential; arbitrary coherent remainders remain open.
